limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the duty cycle but replaced the falling-edge counter decode with a delayed copy of clkp, shifting both divide-by-7 output edges half an input cycle later than the OR-only fix.
The test required the rewrite’s rising-edge phase, so it passed the shifted waveform and would have rejected the correct falling-edge rise.
Testing divisors 2, 6, and 17 led to extra debugging of even-divisor behavior introduced by the rewrite rather than helping fix the requested divide-by-7 circuit.
